_readme: Declares WHERE a service's versions can be read from. Copy to bindings.json and edit.
There is deliberately no inference here: a span says service.name='payments-api' and nothing
in that string identifies a repository. Guessing the mapping would attribute one component's
findings to another and present the result as evidence, so anything not declared below is
reported as UNKNOWN on every request that touches it.
'service' must match the OTel resource attribute service.name exactly.
'declaredBy' is required — an unattributable binding is refused at load.

bindings.note: Python service — backend/requirements.txt is read when present
